title: Eevee Can Start Looking Like Its Trainer
premise: Eevee's unstable genes respond to its surroundings, even making its face resemble its Trainer.
audiencePromise: Show how Eevee's surroundings can turn hidden genetic instability into visible changes.
openLoop: If surroundings shape Eevee, what can its Trainer really change?
payoff: Its design makes hidden genetic influence visible in face and form.
engagementQuestion: Which shapes Eevee more: its surroundings, or its Trainer?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange discovery. Keep the pace quick, warm, and playful. Stress face, surroundings, and Trainer. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: YOUR EEVEE MAY LOOK LIKE YOU
scenes.narration: Eevee's genes can make its face resemble yours.
scenes.caption: THE POKÉDEX SAYS THIS

scenes.headline: SURROUNDINGS LEAVE A MARK
scenes.narration: Even its surroundings can affect Eevee's irregularly configured DNA.
scenes.caption: ENVIRONMENT CAN INFLUENCE ITS GENES

scenes.headline: POTENTIAL BECOMES A NEW SPECIES
scenes.narration: That instability can produce eight different species from one Eevee.
scenes.caption: ONE GENETIC MYSTERY. EIGHT OUTCOMES.

scenes.headline: CHANGE THE ENVIRONMENT
scenes.narration: Change the environment, and Eevee may evolve into another form.
scenes.caption: ITS SURROUNDINGS CAN ALTER ITS FUTURE

scenes.headline: NOT A GUARANTEED COPY
scenes.narration: But the Pokédex says resemblance may happen, not that it must.
scenes.caption: INFLUENCE IS NOT CERTAINTY

scenes.headline: INFLUENCE YOU CAN SEE
scenes.narration: Its design makes hidden genetic influence visible in face and form.
scenes.caption: EEVEE MAKES EVOLUTION FEEL PERSONAL
